what: every column of the PALLAS hackathon pack, with its type, unit and meaning

scan.meaning: which Campaign A scan the row came from: random, or uniform on a grid

config.meaning: ONE SIMULATION -- unique in both campaigns' files, the id every test file joins on and every submission is keyed by

a_0.meaning: laser amplitude, normalised vector potential -- knob

c_N2.meaning: nitrogen concentration, fraction -- Campaign A knob

dE_std.meaning: relative energy spread, standard deviation over mean

dE_mad.meaning: relative energy spread, median absolute deviation over median

z_avg.meaning: mean longitudinal position of the bunch

q_end.meaning: bunch charge -- a 3 pC cut is 3e-12

n_emit_x.meaning: normalised RMS emittance, phase space, x

n_emit_y.meaning: normalised RMS emittance, phase space, y

n_emitTS_x.meaning: normalised trace-space emittance, x -- what div_rms uses

n_emitTS_y.meaning: normalised trace-space emittance, y -- what div_rms uses

div_rms.meaning: RMS divergence, sqrt(emit_x/beta_x + emit_y/beta_y), no (1+alpha^2) factor

envelope_validated.meaning: Campaign A: True iff p_1 <= 73.9 mbar. Up to that pressure the envelope solver's beam matched full-wave reruns; above it the checked runs did not, so treat the beam energy of a False row with care

injected.meaning: the pack's single injection flag, q_pC >= 3.0, identical in all campaigns

ener_axis_MeV.meaning: this row's own spectrum axis, 200 points

spec.meaning: spectrum on this row's own axis, charge per MeV: sum(spec * bin width) = q_pC

spec_common.meaning: spectrum on common_energy_grid_MeV, charge in each shared bin: sum(spec_common) = q_pC

x_p.meaning: position axis of the density profile: 2000 points in Campaign B (the profile ends at L_inj + 3.2 mm), 6 in Campaign A

n_e_p.meaning: helium number density on x_p: 2000 points in Campaign B, 6 in Campaign A

dip_frac.meaning: depth of the dip in the density profile, as a fraction -- Campaign B knob

present_frac.meaning: fraction of the bunch the diagnostic actually saw

q_tot_pC.meaning: total charge of the stored macro-particles

q_raw_pC.meaning: charge before the diagnostic's own selection

injection.meaning: the moments table's own flag; NOT the pack's -- they differ on 8 configurations

xa0_mm.meaning: position of the laser amplitude peak

ts_lo.meaning: lower simulation timestep of the interpolation bracket

ts_hi.meaning: upper simulation timestep of the interpolation bracket

frac.meaning: interpolation weight between ts_lo and ts_hi

interp.meaning: how the plane was reached: interpolated or exact

ref_plane_mm.meaning: the stored plane the moments row was interpolated from

ess.meaning: effective sample size of the weighted moment estimate

charge_closure.meaning: charge consistency check of the moment reconstruction

mean_zeta_um.meaning: bunch centroid, longitudinal, relative to the laser

mean_z_um.meaning: bunch centroid, transverse z -- z is TRANSVERSE in this table

mean_uz.meaning: mean normalised momentum, z, the propagation direction

cov_00.meaning: element (0,0) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_01.meaning: element (0,1) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_02.meaning: element (0,2) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_03.meaning: element (0,3) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_04.meaning: element (0,4) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_05.meaning: element (0,5) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_11.meaning: element (1,1) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_12.meaning: element (1,2) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_13.meaning: element (1,3) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_14.meaning: element (1,4) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_15.meaning: element (1,5) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_22.meaning: element (2,2) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_23.meaning: element (2,3) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_24.meaning: element (2,4) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_25.meaning: element (2,5) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_33.meaning: element (3,3) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_34.meaning: element (3,4) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_35.meaning: element (3,5) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_44.meaning: element (4,4) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_45.meaning: element (4,5) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

cov_55.meaning: element (5,5) of the bunch's 6x6 covariance in (zeta, y, z, ux, uy, uz)

E_std_MeV.meaning: standard deviation of the energy distribution

E_mad_MeV.meaning: median absolute deviation of the energy distribution

sim_id.meaning: the moments table's own id, the string 'Config_<config>'

plane_mm.meaning: position along the accelerator -- the moments table's axis

group.meaning: which corpus the moments row belongs to

P_max.meaning: peak pressure of the gas density profile -- Campaign B knob

cN2_max.meaning: peak nitrogen concentration -- Campaign B knob

L_inj.meaning: length of the injection region -- Campaign B knob; the plasma ends at L_inj + 3.2 mm

dip_frac.meaning: depth of the dip in the density profile, as a fraction -- Campaign B knob
